title: Confirmed: Barcelona squad list to face Alaves – two new faces called up
tweet: Barcelona name the squad for Alaves, adding teenage right‑back Guillem Victor and midfielder Ebrima Tunkara amid injury gaps. Victor covers after Espart’s injury, while Tunkara replaces Olmo. A debut could see Farinas step in, with Frenkie de Jong possibly starting.

title: Flick could field a new-look Barcelona midfield trident against Alaves – report
tweet: Gavi could start against Alaves with Pedri and Rodri – the first time that trio has lined up together – as Flick looks to rotate after Olmo’s month‑long injury and a tight midweek/late‑November schedule. With only 191 minutes this season, Gavi’s energy and pressing make the option attractive, but whether he actually takes the field remains to be seen.

title: Xabi Alonso requests for Chelsea: Barcelona’s top defender in January
tweet: Chelsea's Xabi Alonso has officially requested the signing of Barça defender Jules Kounde in January. As things stand, Kounde’s contract runs until 2030 and he is still fighting for a place, so a move would need his agreement. Whether the Blues can convince him remains to be seen.

title: Barcelona wonderkid could follow in Lamine Yamal’s footsteps and make history against Alaves
tweet: Ebrima Tunkara has been called up after a season‑long injury. He could make his first La Liga appearance against Alavés, becoming Barça’s second‑youngest debutant after Lamine Yamal. Whether that happens remains to be seen.

title: Xabi Alonso rules out January exit for Chelsea prodigy amid Barcelona links
tweet: Alonso confirms Estevao will stay through the winter, stating the 19‑year‑old remains in his plans. As things stand, the midfielder has logged fewer than 50 minutes this term, so a role increase is still unproven. Whether that materialises remains to be seen.

title: Barcelona star’s difficult situation under Hansi Flick deepens despite defensive injury crisis
tweet: Barcelona's defensive injury list leaves only the Frenchman with a quick return, yet Balde still sits on the fringes. Flick's criticism of his attitude and confidence in training has kept him out, despite the need for a left‑back. As things stand, the outcome for Balde remains unclear.
